high_level_description: This image captures a person outdoors on what appears to be a street or sidewalk. The individual is wearing a red shirt and a white scarf with intricate red and gold embroidery along the edges. They have dark hair tied back and are wearing a black helmet with a reflective visor, which covers their eyes and nose. The helmet has a red strap around the chin. The background shows a street scene with some greenery, including trees and a palm tree. There are buildings visible, one of which has a red awning.
